scope: Separate fixed sequential-reweighting experiment; no seen654 or old-results reads; original kernels/models unchanged
grouping: Existing whole-game/identical-before union components; both windows linked; deterministic salted SHA256 group sort then round-robin folds; common bootstrap RNG across costs
selection: MaxTP with FP<=min(referenceFP,floor(.005*N_non_easy_negatives)),TP>=referenceTP,TP>0. Ties fewerFP/highercutoff/highercost. If none feasible select cost5/cutoff5/6 reference and explicit no qualifying improvement.
reference: Cost5/cutoff5/6 retrained on same folds, no deployed-model training leakage
guards: Both-window eligibility+confidence+physicalUnknown abstention for all forest predictions. Easy-error negatives separate; legacy_mixed treated as hard.
final_selection: Independent fixed5fold OOF on all frozen training only; not chosen using outer results. Fullfit once at selectedcost, separate threshold config.
start: Root GO hashes input/script/protocol; browser tabs closed; no active stockfish; no fit before GO

boosting.initial_weights: Each eligible move total1 divided equally over its available eligible windows, normalized across training windows; initialclasscost1
boosting.resampling: None; train only eligible windows from inner/outer training groups
boosting.weak_prediction: Signed weighted leaf majority; ties negative. Weighted counts from unchanged Tree leaf.
boosting.error: Weighted binary misclassification fraction. If >=.5 reject learner and terminate. If exactly0 accept clipped finite-alpha learner then terminate. Else continue to64.
boosting.score: sum(alpha*positivevote)/sum(alpha); no accepted learners =>0(abstain at all gridcutoffs)
boosting.randomness: Same fixed fold salts as prior experiments; round-specific RNG seed independent of labels; no bootstrap

ties: TP, fewerFP, highercutoff, highercost, then lowerdepth/higherminleaf/lowermtry
inference: score_model(model,case,cutoff) in frozen optimize-boosting.py; features/weights only, no labels. Forest fallback exports original features+trees schema unchanged; boost exports kind,features,learners(alpha,tree),score metadata. Cutoff is separate.
